description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe MP as the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs & 40 other Ministers w.e.f. 04.09.2015. Appointed Hon. D. M. Swaminathan MP. Minister of Rehabilitation, Resettlement & Hindu Religious Affairs
categorisation: This gazette contains both the names of specific individuals (e.g., Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, MP) AND detailed descriptions of their ministerial portfolios and responsibilities (e.g., "Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs", "Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs"). This combination of "who" (government personnel) and "what" (detailed portfolio responsibilities) meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
